name: cluecrew
description: ClueCrew - a real-time multiplayer party game: guess who liked, reposted, saved or posted it.

scripts.build: npm --workspace @cluecrew/client run build && npm --workspace @cluecrew/server run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @cluecrew/server run typecheck && npm --workspace @cluecrew/client run typecheck
